res_pre_factOpinionChallenges: Intricacies of certain articles  and bias from right/left-wing
res_pre_newsEvaluationProcess: Once I see a news article that I find fishy, I start with searching for the same article on the internet - If I find similiar information of the same topic I then mark it as credible piece. However if there is a controversy regarding the article - I go over forums that discuss about the article and it's impact and then I go over what folks are talking about and make my judgement based on the sentiments there.
res_pre_aiExpectations: Give me credible pieces of information at a glance, tell me what is fluff and what I should not focus on. Let me know if there are some pieces that have no grounding. Give me other articles to gain more exposure for the same topic. Let me make the decision myself on what I should read and what I think makes sense based on all the evidences that the AI tool gives me.  Help me make an informed decision.

exit_additionalComments: Summarization of the article would be a good feature to have in Task 2. I helps me quickly get up to speed, otherwise there is a lot of content to read in traditional news outlets which becomes mentally draining.
exit_biasDescription: Some news from multiple sources had conflicting opinions, I got to see them first directly in Task 2
exit_personnelInfluenceDescription: Getting to know what the personnel said firsthand made a big difference in how I perceived the article.
